verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
YESU kino kye njagala,
Omwoyo nga gugwo;
-Omugonvu n'omuwombeefu,
Ogukukkiriza.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Omwoyo ogunaazibwa
-Omusaayi gwa Yesu;
Ogutabeeramu kibi,
Ogujjudde-ekisa.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Omwoyo-ogwenkaniddaawo
Ogumpe Katonda;
Oneemale nze kaakati,
Onfugire ddala.
